queries: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(g.n) AS total_records, AVG(g.n - a.m) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.n > a.m

WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT fundflux, avg_ratio, n, AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_kept_sources, SUM(n) AS total_spatial_records, AVG(n - avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_mean_count FROM t WHERE n > avg_n

WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.*, a.avg_cnt FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(cnt) AS total_record_count, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM k

assumptions.assumption: Spatial records are matched to projects with an inner join, so records without a matching project are excluded. A NULL fundflux forms its own group, because GROUP BY puts NULLs together.
The ratio boxy/boxz is computed per record. A record with a NULL boxy or boxz, or with boxz = 0, is ignored in the average through NULLIF. Each source's ratio is the mean of its record ratios.
The final ratio is the unweighted average of the kept sources' per-source average ratios. It is not a record-weighted average.
The cross-source average count is taken over all funding groups, including the NULL group. The comparison is strict (>).

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT fundflux, avg_ratio, n, AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_kept_sources, SUM(n) AS total_spatial_records, AVG(n - avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_mean_count FROM t WHERE n > avg_n

assumptions.assumption: Only spatial records with a matching project are counted (inner join). Records whose project does not exist are excluded.
A NULL fundflux forms its own group, and it counts as one funding source when the cross-source average is computed.

Each source's ratio is the average of the per-record boxy/boxz ratios, not the ratio of sums. Records with a NULL boxy or boxz are ignored by AVG. A boxz of 0 is treated as missing (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero.
The cross-source average count is the unweighted mean of the per-source record counts. The final ratio is the unweighted mean of the kept sources' average ratios.
The number of spatial records is the count of all matched rows, including those with missing boxy or boxz.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.*, a.avg_cnt FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(cnt) AS total_record_count, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM k

assumptions.assumption: Each funding source's ratio is the average of the per-record boxy/boxz values. Records with a missing boxy or boxz are skipped, and a boxz of 0 is treated as missing to avoid division by zero. The final ratio is the unweighted mean of the kept sources' ratios.

Only spatial records that match a project (inner join) are counted. A NULL fundflux forms its own group, because GROUP BY treats NULLs as one group. The cross-source average count is the mean of the per-source counts over all groups, with no weighting.
The count of spatial records is the number of joined rows per source, including rows where the ratio is missing.
